identification: Cold-painted cast metal (most likely lead or spelter; looks toy-like rather than Vienna bronze) cream terrier with black patches and orange collar, harnessed by thin iron shafts to a two-wheeled cart with cast orange spoked wheels, carrying a real murex/spider-conch type shell as the body, green-painted cradle. Seaside souvenir/novelty type, late 19th to early 20th C. L 12 cm.
